reference_character_images.title: Reference Character Images
reference_character_images.description: Upload character reference images as identity-critical anchors. Generated people must preserve the same face likeness, facial proportions, age impression, skin tone, hairline, hair length, hair part, hair volume/style, distinctive marks, wardrobe, and styling continuity rather than using a generic model face. For 3x3 storyboards, include the referenced person only when the beat calls for it; every intentional person/product interaction frame should show a clear visible front-facing or three-quarter referenced face with the product visible for identity and scale. Avoid back-of-head, over-shoulder with visible hair/head but no face, tiny/cropped/blurred faces, or waxy, plastic, CG-looking skin.

reference_product_images.title: Reference Product Images
reference_product_images.description: Upload product reference images. These are the highest-priority product truth source and scale-critical anchors. The generated storyboard must preserve the exact product category/subtype, silhouette, dimensions, countable parts, material, finish, colorway, visible markings/labels, construction details, and scale. Cinematic style, room mood, warm lighting, or environment references must not recolor, resize, redesign, re-materialize, simplify, or replace the referenced product. Treat these images as immutable product evidence; never add, remove, stretch, reshape, recolor, re-texture, relabel, simplify, or redesign the product.

product_label_text.title: Visible Marking / Dimension Text
product_label_text.description: Optional. Use this for exact visible product markings or important product facts that must be preserved, one line per item. This may include brand marks, labels, printed package text, SKU stickers, care labels, engraving, dimensions, capacity, shade name, model name, or physical markings. Do not force large readable text onto the image unless it is physically present or explicitly requested.
examples:
Brand tag on right side seam
SKU sticker under seat
Dimensions: 110 cm long x 50 cm wide x 12 cm thick

image_text_mode.title: Visible Text In Image
image_text_mode.description: Controls whether the generated image may include added visible text such as captions, callouts, infographic labels, headlines, frame numbers, measurement text, or comparison notes. Default is no added text for non-infographic styles. In no_text mode, do not render any added camera-shot abbreviations, technical labels, frame labels, panel labels, corner labels, storyboard_grid text, captions, subtitles, random glyphs, or shorthand such as ECU, CU, MCU, MS, WS, ELS, LS, OS, HA, or LA. Info Graphics Realistic and Info Graphics override this default and require concise large visible infographic text. Physical product markings such as sewn labels, engraved logos, care tags, SKU stickers, printed dimensions, and decorative product text are preserved separately and do not count as added text.

reference_environment_images.title: Reference Environment Images
reference_environment_images.description: Upload environment or location images to guide room type, architecture, floor/wall materials, lighting, color palette, and mood. Environment images are scene references only; they must not override the referenced product geometry, dimensions, colorway, material, or character identity.

storyboard_layout_preset.title: Storyboard Layout Preset
storyboard_layout_preset.description: Single source of truth for the final storyboard canvas, grid columns, grid rows, panel/cell count, and per-cell shape. The skill must decode this preset into the exact LAYOUT LOCK line at the top and after SHOT-BY-SHOT STORYBOARD PROMPT. Do not let aspect_ratio, required_frame_count, storyboard_guide, voiceover_script, or prose instructions override this preset. For canvas_9_16_grid_3x3_frame_9_16_exact, the final prompt must say one single 9:16 image, strict 3x3 grid, EXACTLY 9 PANELS / 9 CELLS ONLY, exactly 3 equal-width columns, exactly 3 equal-height rows, clean narrow gutters between panels, no collage/masonry layout, no labels, no numbers, no text, each panel occupies exactly one cell, never split one panel into two cells, and wide shot means a wide field of view inside a vertical portrait panel, not a horizontal panel. Exact presets keep every cell at 1:1, 16:9, or 9:16. Crop-safe presets reserve extra margin so each frame can be cropped later without cutting off the product or subject.

cinematic_style.title: Cinematic Style
cinematic_style.description: Choose the visual style for the storyboard. Style affects scene, lighting, camera, and mood only; it must not change the referenced product scale, dimensions, product colorway, upholstery/wood/plastic/metal material, hardware, visible markings, or construction details. Warm or luxury styles may affect the room ambience but must not tint, recolor, resize, or redesign the product. Info Graphics Realistic and Info Graphics intentionally create text-forward infographic layouts with large concise readable text; they override the no-text default while still preserving the referenced product. Default storyboard prompts should favor cinematic photorealistic product-film quality with dimensional lighting, realistic lens/depth, and camera choices that match Storyboard Guide plus Voiceover Script; style must not change product geometry, material, labels, colorway, scale, or character identity. Prioritize cinematic photorealistic product-film quality, dimensional lighting, story-matched camera angles, natural human faces, and exact product reference fidelity.

storyboard_guide.title: Storyboard Guide
storyboard_guide.description: Optional storyboard, shot brief, or video-shot guide from Media Studio. When provided, every generated frame prompt must follow this guide's shot order, timing, story beat, action, camera intent, furniture-use intent, scale/room context, and continuity. The guide is a creative direction contract; do not contradict it. If left blank, keep the normal skill behavior.

voiceover_script.title: Voiceover Script / Dialogue
voiceover_script.description: Optional spoken dialogue, narration, or voiceover script from Media Studio. Use this together with Storyboard Guide as the primary shot-by-shot content source. Match each numbered/timed spoken line to the corresponding guide beat; parse shot markers even if whitespace is collapsed. Do not invent a different visual story. Product Detail / Product Facts and reference images still lock the real product, claims, scale, labels, character, and environment fidelity.

production_concept_details.title: Product Detail / Product Facts
production_concept_details.description: Product Detail / Product Facts and concept context. Use as the real product truth lock for product type, model, dimensions, countable parts, material, color, style, intended use, claim safety, audience, problem, hook, and selling points. Storyboard Guide + Voiceover Script control the shot story; Product Detail controls exact product truth. Do not add prices, ratings, sold counts, promotions, certifications, or claims that were not supplied.

image_attempt_number.title: Image Attempt Number
image_attempt_number.description: Marketplace Auto Review image attempt number. Use this together with Image Attempt Story Lens so every retry is a fresh skill call with a distinct customer-journey perspective instead of copying the previous storyboard prompt.

image_attempt_story_lens_id.title: Image Attempt Story Lens ID
image_attempt_story_lens_id.description: Stable identifier for the customer-journey lens selected for this image attempt. Keep it as planning metadata only; do not render it as visible text.

image_attempt_story_lens_title.title: Image Attempt Story Lens Title
image_attempt_story_lens_title.description: Short title of the customer-journey perspective for this attempt. Use it to vary the hook/proof/usage emphasis while preserving product truth.

image_attempt_story_lens.title: Image Attempt Story Lens
image_attempt_story_lens.description: Attempt-specific customer-journey direction for fresh prompt generation. The skill must use this as the active story lens for the prompt, preserving the same product truth and shot order while making frame composition, hook situation, proof emphasis, scene rhythm, camera palette, and human presence meaningfully different from prior image attempts.

product_category.title: Product Category
product_category.description: Choose the product category rule file for product-specific fidelity checks. Production auto-detects this from Product Detail, product title, marketplace category, and references. Use Auto only when uncertain; selected category rules are fallback constraints and never override reference_product_images or Product Detail.
